name: Scribe Mail
description:
Scribe is email signature management for teams: IT sets it up once, marketing runs it, and no employee ever installs anything.

Connect Scribe to Claude and manage your workspace in plain language:

- Create, edit, preview and publish signature templates
• Assign signatures to teammates, groups and folders
• Manage smart fields, assets and integrations
• Launch, schedule and pause banner campaigns
• Pull view, click and conversion analytics

Signatures deploy centrally across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and 30+ tools. Sign in with your Scribe account via OAuth — the connector forwards your own access token and never stores an API key.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Scribe Mail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Scribe Mail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.scribe-mail.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Scribe Mail MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scribe Mail lists 64 MCP tools, including add_signature_recipient_entities, add_signature_recipients, create_asset, create_email, create_folder, create_marketing_campaign, create_signature, create_smart_field, create_teammate, delete_asset, delete_email, and delete_folder.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Scribe Mail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Scribe Mail in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Scribe Mail MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scribe Mail requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Scribe Mail is developed by Scribe Mail. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
